rationale: A cluster state update is a hot path, and the new delta copies both project-id sets on every update with more than the default project, even when nothing changed. ocra reported it in all four runs on this pull request, and an AACR-Bench reference written by a person makes the same point. The first performance expectation in the set. ADR-0036: kept; the pull request's next commit added the identity check the reference asked for; base set to the merge base.

expect.concern: calculateProjectDelta builds two Sets.difference copies of the project ids on every cluster state update with more than the default project, even when the projects did not change; a check for the same metadata or equal key sets would skip them.
